Task: Click a word tile to toggle its selection state.
Expected Result: Tile selection toggles (e.g., visually highlighted with lift/brighten on select, normal state on deselect). A maximum of 4 words can be selected. The 'Submit Group' button is enabled only when exactly 4 words are selected, otherwise it is disabled.

Note: The task is only considered successful if the expected result is achieved; otherwise, it is deemed infeasible.
